rows.label: Entry course: ENGRD 2610 or ENGRD 2620
rows.note: One of the two cross-listed engineering distribution courses.

rows.label: Two core MSE courses from the seven listed
rows.note: Each course must carry at least 3 credits so the six courses reach 18 credits.

rows.label: Three MSE electives numbered 3000 or above (3+ credits each, research courses held out)
rows.note: Counts MSE courses at 3000+ only. Research and independent-study numbers (4900-4999) and the thesis, MEng project and research courses (titled Senior Thesis, Research in Materials Science, and MEng Project) are held out because the page allows research for at most 3 credits; confirm that separately. Courses from other departments need the MSE coordinator, so they are a confirm row, not counted here.

rows.label: Confirm any elective taken from another department's 3000+ materials courses is approved as allowable
rows.note: The page lists departments, not courses, and sends questions to the MSE Undergraduate Coordinator. Not counted on the board; if you use one in place of an MSE elective, confirm it here and with the coordinator.

rows.label: Confirm any research-involvement course used as an elective, counting at most 3 of its credits
rows.note: Research courses are held out of the MSE elective row; if you use one, confirm its credits and that you still reach three electives and 18 credits.

rows.label: Confirm the six minor courses add up to at least 18 credits
rows.note: The rows already require 3+ credits per course; this reminds you to check the total.

rows.label: Confirm a C or better in every course counted for the minor
Confirm your major approves taking this minor (it cannot be your Materials Science and Engineering major)
rows.note: The MSE major bar is handled in the minor picker.

rows.label: Complete all undergraduate degree requirements and finish the minor during continuous enrollment at Cornell
rows.note: The board cannot see overall degree completion.

rows.label: Apply for certification of the minor after the coursework is finished
rows.note: The transcript notation appears after graduation.
